let split := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 5 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p%4=1); let localProd := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ split z, (1 - 2/(p : ℝ)); (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0<s.re → s.re<1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s=0 → s.re=1/2)→
∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℕ => Real.log (z : ℝ) * localProd z) Filter.atTop (nhds c)

brief.zh: 用 log(1−2/p)+2/p 的绝对可和性。修正积可复用 QP-0075。奇数 p≡3 mod 4 的局部因子等于一，4k²+1 在 2 处无根。
brief.en: Use the absolute summability of log(1−2/p)+2/p. QP-0075 gives the correction product. The inert primes have factor one, and 4k²+1 has no root at 2.
